[ASSISTANT_SAID] Acid reflux can be alleviated by avoiding certain foods and incorporating others into the diet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Foods to avoid for acid reflux include:  
1. Citrus fruits and juices  
2. Tomatoes and tomato-based products  
3. Fatty and fried foods  
4. Spicy and acidic foods  
5. Caffeine and carbonated drinks  
6. Chocolate  
7. Mint  
8. Processed meats  
9. Garlic and onions  
10. Alcohol  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Foods to eat for acid reflux include:  
1. Lean proteins  
2. Whole grains  
3. Vegetables  
4. Fiber-rich foods  
5. Ginger  
6. Oatmeal  
7. Yogurt  
8. Alkaline fruits  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for managing acid reflux include:  
1. Eat smaller, more frequent meals  
2. Avoid lying down after eating  
3. Raise the head of your bed  
4. Stay hydrated  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested meal prep strategies include:  
1. Batch cooking  
2. One-pot meals  
3. Slow cooker meals  
4. Prepping ingredients in advance  
5. Using leftovers  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested time-saving meal planning tips include:  
1. Meal planning around the user's schedule

3. Creating grocery lists
